text: Based on the evidence, there is no confirmed tree-cover loss on the property in 2020. While one source (Hansen/UMD) mapped about 0.7 ha of tree-cover loss, the independent JRC 2020 reference did not agree with this detection. Therefore, the claim of tree-cover loss in 2020 is contradicted. However, it's important to note that this does not necessarily mean no tree-cover loss occurred, but rather that it was not confirmed by the independent reference. The cause or type of any potential change also cannot be determined from this evidence.
